name: Affirmations
description: A soothing, daily affirmation app to improve mental health and positivity.
author: Moldable

capabilities.name: Affirmations
capabilities.description: Read affirmation categories, affirmation text, random affirmations, and favorites.

scopes.name: Read the mobile Affirmations experience
scopes.description: Return a route-specific, bounded NativeUI projection for home, today's affirmation, a theme, one affirmation, favorites, or a random affirmation.

scopes.name: Update the mobile Affirmations experience
scopes.description: Perform a low-risk per-affirmation favorite change or request another random affirmation, returning only a bounded receipt.

scopes.name: List affirmations
scopes.description: List affirmations, optionally filtered by category or text.

scopes.name: Random affirmation
scopes.description: Return one random affirmation, optionally constrained by category or query.

scopes.name: List favorites
scopes.description: List favorite affirmations in this workspace.

capabilities.name: Drive the Affirmations UI
capabilities.description: Describe, navigate, and read the running Affirmations UI so an assistant can visibly drive the app (open today's affirmation, a theme deck, or the favorites list) and read the content behind any view. All of these are non-destructive: they only change what is displayed or read data.

scopes.name: Describe UI views
scopes.description: List every navigable view in the Affirmations UI. Returns { views: [{ id, name, description, params? }] } explaining what each view shows and what entityId/params mean for it. Call this before affirmations.ui.navigate when unsure which view id to target.

scopes.name: Navigate the UI
scopes.description: Navigate the open Affirmations UI to a view. The running client applies the change visibly; nothing is modified. view is a view id from affirmations.ui.describe. entityId is the category id (from affirmations.categories) and is required when view is "category". params carries view-specific options: { text } for "category" picks the affirmation to show first. Returns { ok: true, intentId }.

entityId.description: Category id (from affirmations.categories). Required when view is "category".

params.description: View-specific options: { text: string } for "category" shows that exact affirmation first (best-effort).

scopes.name: Show today's affirmation
scopes.description: Open the full-screen card with today's affirmation (one fixed affirmation per calendar day). Purely visual navigation; nothing is modified. Returns { ok: true, intentId, dayKey, text } where text is today's affirmation.

scopes.name: Shuffle to a random affirmation
scopes.description: Pick one random affirmation from any theme and visibly show it in the full-screen theme viewer, like the in-app shuffle button. Purely visual navigation; nothing is modified. Returns { ok: true, intentId, affirmation: { text, categoryId, categoryName } } with the affirmation now on screen.

scopes.name: Read a view's content
scopes.description: Read the content behind the current or a target Affirmations view as structured JSON straight from the data layer (no pixels, no HTML). With no params, returns the home dashboard: today's affirmation, streak days, favorites count, and every theme with its affirmation count. With view "daily", returns today's affirmation and whether it is a favorite. With view "category" and entityId set to a category id (entityId alone also works), returns that theme's full affirmation list with per-item favorite flags. With view "favorites", returns the saved favorites list.

view.description: Optional view id to read. Defaults to the home dashboard (or the category view when entityId is given).

entityId.description: Optional category id to read (required when view is "category").

capabilities.name: Chat cards
capabilities.description: Show a chosen affirmation as a quiet styled card with the full text on tap.

scopes.name: Present chat card
scopes.description: Show a chosen affirmation as a quiet styled card with the full text on tap.

scopes.name: Read chat card
scopes.description: Show a chosen affirmation as a quiet styled card with the full text on tap.

tagline: Daily affirmations across ten themes, saved to your favorites
